description: Defines the FileSelectListener class which monitors a file for changes, reads its contents, and executes a callback function upon data availability. Implements file existence checks, polling loop with select, and thread management.

classes.name: FileSelectListener
classes.description: A class that monitors a specified file for changes, reads new data, and triggers a callback function in a separate thread.

methods.name: FileSelectListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the monitoring thread for the specified file.

methods.name: ~FileSelectListener
methods.description: Destructor that signals the thread to stop and joins it.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if the specified file exists and is accessible.

methods.name: pollLoop
methods.description: Main loop that polls the file for changes, reads data, and executes the callback.
